target_claim.question: Does the frozen edge-partition subfamily contain H/I > 40/17?
target_claim.known_baseline: one address has constant 2; two-address witness has 40/17

family.residual: g is zero on their six-vertex union and arbitrary +/-1 on the complement
family.retention: the normalized squared Walsh law of g is product
family.boolean_realizability: pointwise exactly one summand is nonzero and sign-valued

symmetry_reduction.edge_slice_signs: fixed because they do not change squared spectra or influence
symmetry_reduction.edge_partition_per_union: one representative; each edge slice has identical entropy and expected physical degree and labels have total degree 4
symmetry_reduction.completeness: complete for H/I within the displayed family, not for all C022 functions

exact_conventions.truth_table_order: integers x=0..15; y=0..3 varies fastest in full table; bit 0 least significant
exact_conventions.walsh: unnormalized integer transform; normalized coefficients divide by 16 for residual and 64 for full function
